input.summary: Raise the liability cap to the greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1,000,000 and confirm Excluded Claims sit outside the cap
input.comment: [Playbook] We have raised the mutual cap to the greater of twelve months' Fees (paid or payable) and USD 1,000,000, which is our standard position; a one-month fee cap is far below any meaningful measure of risk here. We also removed "without exception" so that the Excluded Claims in Section 21.3 — indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement — remain uncapped as that Section contemplates. Our fallback is a mutual cap of twelve months' Fees with those carve-outs preserved.

ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to this limitation, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
